checks: Gameplay default/native12/save gates retained; lifecycle modes select exact env values and unknown mode fails.

Lifecycle injection now requires current Loading observation, actual present ticket/generation and increase of native raw success counter during that frame. Legal acquire no-image is not counted as presented. V1 lacked this gate and must not be used.
pending=true proves preparation owner awaiting handoff, not necessarily running worker; completed unpublished Apps still require join/disposal. Source wording now explicit.
Suspended mode invokes existing actual Suspended then Close with no Resume, checks target.exiting and owner removal before LoopExiting. LoopExiting fallback cannot create this earlier success flag.
Ordinary loading_close preserves real Close queue→frame→ShutdownGameCmd consumer→renderer cleanup; final requires actual ShutdownGame marker.
UserEvent watchdog records error before exit, and existing result Some(Err) prevents LoopExiting from overwriting failure with success. Stop channel and join guard do not leave timer thread detached.
No frame threshold relaxation in original Gameplay mode, no fake device/monitor/image, no forced worker success, no live production mutation.
execution_limits: Not compiled or OS/GPU executed by this reviewer.
Watchdog wakes an OS loop blocked in Wait but cannot preempt a native call or synchronously hung shutdown; real bounded production GPU waits remain necessary.
Native present success is the backend native result, not physical scanout or image correctness proof.
Close tests do not cover every resize/suspend/WSI failure branch.
